title: Complete your order
subtitle: Just three steps: shipping details, payment method and confirmation.

shipping.title: Shipping details
shipping.description: Used to deliver your Ao Dai and to contact you about measurements or alterations.
shipping.emailHint: For order confirmation and delivery updates
shipping.notesPlaceholder: E.g. deliver during office hours, call before delivery…

payment.title: Payment method
payment.description: Choose how you would like to pay for your order.

cod.title: Cash on delivery (COD)
cod.description: Pay the courier in cash after receiving and checking your Ao Dai.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.description: Account details are shown at the review step. Your order is processed once payment arrives.

card.title: Credit / debit card
card.description: Visa, Mastercard, JCB and domestic cards.

payment.cardNote: After placing your order you will be redirected to a secure payment gateway to enter your card. AODAI never stores your card number.

review.title: Review your order
review.description: Please check your details before placing the order.

bank.title: Bank transfer details
bank.contentHint: Use this exact reference so we can confirm your order quickly

review.customNote: Your order includes made-to-measure items: our tailor will call to confirm measurements before cutting (7–10 days to complete).
review.agreement: By clicking “Place order”, you agree to AODAI's purchase and return policies.

empty.title: Nothing to check out yet
empty.description: Your cart is empty. Pick the designs you love before checking out.

success.title: Thank you for choosing AODAI
success.description: Your order has been received and is being prepared.
success.emailNote: An order confirmation has been sent to {email}.
success.bankReminder: Please transfer using the reference below so we can process your order as soon as possible.
success.cardReminder: You will receive an email with instructions to complete your card payment through our secure gateway.

next.confirm: We call to confirm your order within 24 business hours.
next.prepare: Your Ao Dai is inspected, pressed and gift-boxed.
next.ship: Delivery in 2–4 days (7–10 days for made-to-measure).
